newsitem.title: DENMARK: Tele Danmark to cut Scandinavian tariffs.
newsitem.headline: Tele Danmark to cut Scandinavian tariffs.

text.p: Danish telecommunications group Tele Danmark said on Friday it planned to cut telephone call charges from Denmark to other Scandinavian countries for all subscribers from November 1.
"We are putting international call charges within Scandinavia down by 20 percent, both during daytime and in the evening," Tele Danmark executive Tom Togsvaerd told Reuters.

The group earlier said it would give discounts of up to 20 percent on international calls to large business customers. On intra-Scandinavian calls the business reductions would be calculated from the new, cheaper base rate, Togsvaerd said.

Tele Danmark, facing increased competition since deregulation last July, was partially privatised in 1994 with the Danish state holding on to a 51 percent stake. --Eva Elgaard Pedersen, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969652
